title: ChatGPT Needs SPADE (Sustainability, PrivAcy, Digital divide, and Ethics) Evaluation: A Review.

bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative review of secondary sources and social media reports regarding model responses to prompts about torture justification and security risks associated with specific nationalities.
Qualitative evaluation based on secondary literature and news articles highlighting instances of racial profiling and discriminatory responses generated by the model.
Qualitative review of anecdotal examples from secondary sources involving prompts about the surveillance of houses of worship and the generation of Islamophobic content.

Quantitative analysis of statistical data (UNCTAD, ITU, SimilarWeb) comparing internet speeds, share of skilled workers, and ChatGPT web traffic across low, middle, and high-income countries to evaluate access disparities.
